hero.subtext: Video Editor & Motion Designer specializing in cinematic edits, social content, motion graphics and visual storytelling.

about.portraitCaption: ALEX MERCER — VIDEO EDITOR & MOTION DESIGNER
about.bioParagraph1: I'm a video editor focused on transforming raw footage into engaging visual stories. The timeline is where I think — pacing, rhythm and emotion are decided frame by frame.
about.bioParagraph2: My work combines editing, motion graphics, visual effects, sound design and color to create videos that are visually strong and emotionally engaging. If it doesn't serve the story, it doesn't make the cut.

process.title: RAW FOOTAGE
process.description: Ingesting and logging every clip. Nothing gets lost, everything gets marked.

process.title: SELECTS
process.description: Pulling the strongest moments — the takes with genuine energy.

process.title: ROUGH CUT
process.description: Establishing structure, pacing and narrative flow.

process.title: FINE CUT
process.description: Trimming to the frame. Rhythm becomes intention.

process.title: MOTION
process.description: Adding typography, transitions and visual effects.

process.title: COLOR
process.description: Creating consistency and developing the final visual mood.

process.title: SOUND
process.description: Sound design, SFX and music mixed for impact.

process.title: FINAL
process.description: Mastered, exported and delivered for every platform.

experienceTimeline.desc: Leading end-to-end edits for brand and creator clients — from raw footage to final delivery.
Animated typography, title sequences and motion systems for campaigns.
Short-form content, music edits and personal cinematic projects.

projects.title: Cinematic Trailer Edit
projects.description: A high-energy trailer cut built around rhythm and restraint — every beat mapped to the music, every transition earned. Graded for a cold, filmic finish with deep blacks and controlled highlights.

RAW.desc: Flat S-Log3 footage straight from the camera, preserving all shadow and highlight details for grading.

EDIT.desc: Pacing edit matching high-impact cuts and narrative transitions to the trailer's sound design.

COLOR.desc: A cold cinematic color grade with styled steel-blue midtones and clean, rolled highlights.

MOTION.desc: Kinetic tracked titles and kinetic text overlays positioned in 3D space.

SOUND.desc: Sub-bass impacts, risers, and detailed ambient sound design built from raw foley libraries.

FINAL.desc: The fully mastered 4K export, completed with theater-ready audio mixing and grading.
